orchestration_result.query: Build me a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only.

bonds.analysis: Given a 5-year horizon, we can structure a laddered bond portfolio to provide a smooth amortization of principal and interest. To achieve this, we'll allocate 20% to each of the 5 buckets representing the 5-year maturity ladders. This approach ensures no more than 30% of the portfolio will mature in a single year, meeting the laddered maturity structure requirement. We'll focus on allocating to the shortest tenors first, prioritizing creditworthiness and minimizing duration. The bonds below are high-quality examples used for illustrative purposes.

Revisit asset allocation to ensure compliance with the 40% cap. Allocation cannot be made without rebalancing the affected assets.
